verdict.rationale: Qodo lets customers control where their data lives by deploying entirely within their own infrastructure. Documented options include on-premises, single-tenant and air-gapped deployments [qodo-docs-16][qodo-docs-39][qodo-docs-40], which gives residency control through self-hosting. However, nothing documents choosing a storage region for the hosted multi-tenant service, so residency control effectively requires running Qodo yourself. Missing for 10: selectable data region/residency for the hosted SaaS, explicit data-residency documentation, independent corroboration.
